data.body: [P1] A plugin fatal error can still leave the invocation blocked indefinitely. `stopAllOperations()` fails operation completion futures but does not stop an already-running user-handler task; `close()` subsequently waits without a timeout for every such task. With parallel/map work, a fatal hook in one branch therefore cannot terminate the invocation while another branch is blocked, preventing propagation and plugin release until Lambda times out. Track and interrupt/cancel running handler tasks when a plugin fatal is recorded, and bound the cleanup wait using the invocation deadline. Add a regression test with a blocked, already-running peer branch.
